title: On Coughing all through the long sermon
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：cough　|　正文 348 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cough 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1982 the guide ① coughed all through the long sermon in the rain, and every traveller in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the guide ② coughs all through the long sermon without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ cough all through the long sermon at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ coughed all through the long sermon before — a line in the guidebook for July 1976 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Coughing all through the long sermon in the rain, the guide said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the map at the far ledge, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ cough up the smoke of the city without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Cough up the smoke of the city at once and never mention it again.

By 1989 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the guidebook, and a new traveller from the next valley ⑧ coughs up the smoke of the city in the rain every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ledge, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ coughed all through the long sermon again when nobody else would.

⑩ To cough all through the long sermon, my mother said in 1994, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the valley remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the valley forgets, somebody coughs all through the long sermon without complaint again and somebody must cough all through the long sermon in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 咳嗽（一般过去式 coughed all through the long sermon：1982 年向导头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 咳嗽（一般现在 coughs all through the long sermon：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 咳嗽（不定式 to cough all through the long sermon：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 咳嗽（过去完成时 had coughed all through the long sermon：1976 年七月的旅行手册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 咳嗽（动名词 coughing all through the long sermon 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 咳出（cough up the smoke of the city：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去咳出把城里的烟咳出来）
G. v. 咳出（cough up the smoke of the city：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 咳嗽（后段两处：新来的旅人照例 coughs up the smoke of the city，而母亲又一次 coughed all through the long sermon）

answers.why: cough 意为“咳嗽”，1982 年向导淋着雨咳嗽整场长长的布道里一直在咳，那是山谷里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 coughed。
cough 意为“咳嗽”，自那以后向导毫无怨言地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 coughs。
cough 意为“咳嗽”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯咳嗽整场长长的布道里一直在咳”，此处为不定式 to cough all through the long sermon。
cough 意为“咳嗽”，旅行手册里 七月 那行字说明早在 1989 年之前就有人咳嗽过，故用过去完成时 had coughed。
cough 意为“咳嗽”，向导说“咳嗽整场长长的布道里一直在咳这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 coughing all through the long sermon 作主语。
cough 意为“咳出”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去咳出把城里的烟咳出来”，should ever 之后用原形 cough up the smoke of the city。
cough 意为“咳出”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻咳出把城里的烟咳出来（cough up the smoke of the city at once），以后再也不要提起。
cough 意为“咳嗽”，新来的旅人每个日子都照例咳出把城里的烟咳出来，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 coughs。
cough 意为“咳嗽”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次淋着雨咳嗽整场长长的布道里一直在咳，用一般过去式 coughed 叙述。
cough 意为“咳嗽”，结尾那句是母亲 1994 年的话：要咳嗽整场长长的布道里一直在咳，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和山谷记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1982 年，向导淋着雨咳嗽整场长长的布道里一直在咳；山谷里每一个旅人都说这是头一回。（coughed all through the long sermon）
多年以后，向导仍毫无怨言地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（coughs all through the long sermon）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯咳嗽整场长长的布道里一直在咳这件事本身。（to cough all through the long sermon）
早在 1976 年就有人咳嗽整场长长的布道里一直在咳，七月那天旅行手册上的一行字就是证据。（had coughed all through the long sermon）
向导说过，淋着雨咳嗽整场长长的布道里一直在咳这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（coughing all through the long sermon 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻咳出把城里的烟咳出来，以后再也不要提起。（cough up the smoke of the city，祈使句）
answers: In 1982 the guide coughed all through the long sermon in the rain, and every traveller in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three days on, the guide still coughs all through the long sermon without complaint without being asked.
My mother said later that to cough all through the long sermon at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had coughed all through the long sermon long before 1989, and the line in the guidebook for July proves it.
Coughing all through the long sermon in the rain, the guide said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 cough 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1982 the guide coughed all through the long sermon in the rain, and nobody in the valley forgot it.
Even now the guide coughs all through the long sermon without complaint whenever the valley asks.
Coughing all through the long sermon in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever cough up the smoke of the city without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new traveller from the next valley coughs up the smoke of the city in the rain every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother coughed all through the long sermon again, and the valley remembered that half.
